facts.text: Jolene recommends Zelda BOTW for Switch as an open-world game and Animal Crossing: New Horizons as a calming and cute game.

evidence.quote: I have a few game recommendations. Zelda BOTW for Switch is an awesome open-world game. Animal Crossing: New Horizons is really calming and cute.

facts.text: Jolene mentions playing Overcooked 2 with her partner, often for bets, and once won three large pizzas.

evidence.quote: I once won three large pizzas!

facts.text: Deborah recalls playing video games with her husband, which she describes as a way to bond and make memories.

evidence.quote: Reminds me of when I used to play games with my husband. We'd take turns and it was a great way to bond and make memories.

facts.text: Jolene states that it is hard to choose a single favorite game.

evidence.quote: As for my favorite game, it's hard to choose just one!
